access_methods: Google Routes API v2 computeRoutes (DRIVE, TRAFFIC_AWARE_OPTIMAL, waypoints as via points)

metrics.not_evaluated: ETA -- not a research question or metric of this thesis

antroute.algorithm: ACO on the risk-weighted graph with the Event-Aware layer

event_layer.cost_term: W = dist * (1 + lambda * Risk) * (1 + mu * Event)

strength.edges_affected: every edge touching the incident's intersection
strength.overlap: strongest live incident, not the sum; Event in [0, 1]

decay.shape: linear from the base impact at the report time to 0

event_layer.matching: configs/event_landmarks.csv -> intersection; unmatched alerts are dropped

baseline.flow_term: mean YOLO vehicle count per camera per window (auto_labels.csv)
baseline.plans_on: observed camera congestion (weak_target), not ANTROUTE's predicted risk
